scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.setup-pnpm: node -e "try{require('child_process').execSync('corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.error('corepack not available — run `npm i -g pnpm` or use your OS package manager', e)}"
